item.title: Deshaun Hill murder: Cody Fohrenkam sentenced to 28 years in prison

item.title: Minnesota lawmakers want schools to teach cursive again
item.description: A new bill in Minnesota aims to bring cursive handwriting back to elementary schools.Cursive handwriting curriculumA proposal in the Minnesota Senate would require the Commissioner of Education to develop a model curriculum for cursive handwriting. The goal is for students to achieve legible cursive skills by the end of grade 5.Cursive proposalThe proposal pulls funds from the general fund to provide grants to school districts to adopt the cursive curriculum.
